title: Brackenfield Markets: API rate limits and the planned GCP maintenance window

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Hi, it's Ruth from integrations at Brackenfield Markets. Two quick ones for you.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Since Monday we've been getting 429s on the positions endpoint. What's the rate limit now?

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: It's per API key. A hundred requests per ten seconds, with bursts up to two hundred. That hasn't changed.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Odd, we never used to hit it. Can you see which key is making the most calls?

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: Not from here, no. I'll pull the gateway logs and send you a breakdown by key.

lines.speaker: Them
lines.text: Thanks for that. What about Saturday's maintenance? Is copy trading affected?

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: It's a database upgrade on our Google Cloud side, six till eight a.m. UK time. Markets are shut, so copy trading isn't affected, but the API is read-only for about twenty minutes.

lines.speaker: Me
lines.text: We've rehearsed the rollback. Um, if it's not done by half seven, we roll back and try again next weekend.
